title: CRUCIBLE blind engine database: sealed outcomes
description: Written only by the sealed step (PREDICTION_PROTOCOL.md), after the batch's prediction commit exists, by an agent that has not seen the predictions. One file per scored batch: sealed/<batch>.json. No such file exists before its batch's prediction commit.

prediction_commit.description: Checked to be an ancestor of HEAD before anything was written.

prediction_sha256.description: SHA-256 of predictions.json at prediction_commit, checked against REGISTER.md.

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 of engines.json as the prediction recorded it.

written.description: ISO date-time, and who wrote it (the agent and its brief).

label.description: The source's own label. Only test and flight count as validation; the rest are rating or model comparisons (as RL10A33A_PROTOCOL.md section 5).

source.description: A key of the engine's sources in engines.json, or a new id defined in sources below.

basis.description: Isp and mass flow: on the engine's whole flow (open cycles include the turbine flow) or the chamber's.

ambient_pressure_mpa.description: Sea-level and test-cell values: the printed ambient pressure, if any.

operating_point_match.description: How the values correspond to the spec's operating_point.label; any mismatch said here, not corrected.

alternates.description: Other printed values for the same point: recorded, never scored.
